decisions.evidence: 1336+1412 ~22+19/day in Oct 2024 vs ~108+93 in Dec 2024 and 23+18 in May 2025; 451 1234+1303 ~14+12 -> ~2+2; 450 ~30 -> ~53 each way; IN and OUT totals across the camera stay balanced (~85/85 Oct, ~190/180 Dec); 453 profile after is flat through daylight in both directions.

decisions.diagnosis: The footpath zone fell from ~12 to ~1-3 bikes/day per direction at the same step as 453 rose, consistent with riders moving to the north path or with a zone redefinition; many later days are unpublished (all-zero days omitted by the feed).
decisions.evidence: 1234 Oct 2024 14/day -> Dec 2/day; 1303 12 -> 2; step on 2024-11-07/08 coincides with 453 jump; from mid-2025 1234/1303 have 10-15 absent days per month.

summary: One VivaCity-style camera (C0001401) at Parke Ave/Kullaiba Rd, Kotara, split into seven zones, with continuous, internally consistent data (camera-wide IN and OUT totals balance) from 2024-03-25 to 2025-10-03. The first day is pre-installation zeros until ~17:00 and is set missing; every zero_outage fix fell on a camera-wide rain day or in 451's post-November low regime and is restored. A camera-wide step on about 2024-11-08 (453 up ~5x, 450 up ~1.8x, 451 down to ~0) is left as recorded but flagged uncertain for 451 and 453, since it may be new infrastructure or a zone reconfiguration.
